response: This lawsuit against ICE is just another progressive scheme to tie the hands of law enforcement and weaken our borders. The arrests and detentions right as these individuals leave court demonstrate agents carrying out their duty to remove people trying to manipulate the system for legal status they likely don't deserve. Claims of false information from ICE lawyers and some agency memo from May of last year offering no authorization are the usual excuses from those who want to undermine authority. Officials citing it anyway makes sense when the priority is protecting national sovereignty and social order over bureaucratic games. We need to back enforcement firmly instead of falling for calls to reform the system in ways that erode personal responsibility and cultural continuity.
